commercialPurpose: Structure trip planning through destination cards, route/map logic, and staged itinerary modules.
purposeLayer: Process converts travel emotion into clear packages, route choices, and booking confidence.
anatomyLayer: Large scenic card, small destination cards, map-like route panels, step cards, checklist modules, and testimonial proof near the end.
hierarchyLayer: Featured destination first, grouped steps second, proof/reviews third.
gridRhythmLayer: Dark vertical itinerary layout alternating scenic media blocks with compact route cards.
densityLimitLayer: Use section density limit: {"steps": "3-6", "supportingMedia": "0-1", "branching": "avoid unless product requires"}.
originalityLayer: Extract section grammar only; do not copy exact artwork, imagery, spacing, copy, color identity, brand marks, or section order.
usageRuleLayer: Use when travel/offline service templates need process clarity without becoming a generic numbered step row.
layoutGesture: travel itinerary sequence with scenic cards and route modules
sectionSilhouette: stacked dark process section with big landscape cards beside smaller trip detail cards
compositionTension: adventure imagery keeps emotion high while process cards reduce booking uncertainty
focalPath: featured trip image to route cards to steps to review proof
negativeSpaceShape: dark gutters create journey pauses between photo-heavy blocks
depthLayering: background dark field, photo cards, elevated route cards, small metadata chips
moduleScaleVariation: one large scenic block paired with several small itinerary cards
breakoutBehavior: scenic cards can break row rhythm to feel like an expedition board
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact mountain photography, route labels, card styling, or package names.
